whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.text:
Parras General Services delivers commercial cleaning and maintenance with a simple goal: do the job right, on time, and with results you can see.

Founded in 2019 by a friend who started the company alone, Parras grew from one-person dedication into a committed team focused on quality, consistency, and respect for every space we serve. Today we help businesses keep their environments clean, safe, and professional—supported by clear processes and direct communication.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To deliver reliable, consistent cleaning and maintenance services with attention to detail—so our clients can focus on their business while we take care of the cleanliness and presentation.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be recognized as a trusted long-term partner for commercial cleaning in Canada, known for professionalism, punctuality, and standards that stay consistent.

values.title: Our Values
values.respectDesc: For your space, your time, and our team.

different.title: Built with Pride, Maintained with Standards
different.text: Our standards are built for Canadian businesses: structured processes, reliable scheduling, and quality checks that protect your brand image.

howWeWork.title: How We Work
howWeWork.step1Desc: We review your space and goals to create a clear plan.
howWeWork.step1Detail: Our team conducts a thorough walkthrough of your facility to understand your needs, traffic patterns, and specific requirements.
howWeWork.step2Desc: We establish a high standard with a detailed first clean.
howWeWork.step2Detail: The first session sets the benchmark—every surface, corner, and detail receives full attention to establish our quality standard.
howWeWork.step3Desc: We keep your business consistently clean with a scheduled plan.
howWeWork.step3Detail: With a customized cleaning schedule, we maintain the standard day after day, adapting to your operational needs.
howWeWork.step4Desc: We check results regularly to maintain the standard.
howWeWork.step4Detail: Regular inspections and feedback loops ensure nothing slips through—your space stays clean and professional.

grid.retailInc3: Floor care for heavy foot traffic
grid.windowCleaningDesc: Professional interior and exterior window cleaning for commercial buildings, storefronts, and office spaces—streak-free results every time.
grid.powerWashingDesc: High-pressure cleaning for building exteriors, sidewalks, parking areas, and loading docks that removes grime, mold, and built-up dirt.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How often should my business be cleaned?
faq.a1: It depends on foot traffic and your industry. Most commercial spaces benefit from daily or weekly cleaning schedules. We can help determine the best frequency during our site evaluation.
faq.q2: Do you bring supplies and equipment?
faq.a2: Yes, we bring all necessary cleaning supplies and professional-grade equipment. If you have preferred products or specific requirements, we're happy to accommodate.
faq.q3: Can you work after business hours?
faq.a3: Absolutely. We offer flexible scheduling including evenings, early mornings, and weekends to minimize disruption to your operations.
faq.a4: Yes, every cleaning plan is tailored to your space, needs, and budget. We work with you to build a plan that makes sense for your business.
faq.a5: We focus on high-touch surfaces such as door handles, light switches, elevator buttons, shared desks, and washroom fixtures. We can also provide full-room disinfection when needed.
faq.a6: Simply fill out our contact form or call us directly. We'll schedule a site evaluation and provide a detailed quote at no cost.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Parras General Services ("we", "us", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information in compliance with Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).
privacy.section1Text: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when you submit our contact form, including your name, email address, phone number, company name, address, and message details. We also collect basic usage data through cookies to improve your experience on our website.
privacy.section2Text: We use the information you provide to respond to your inquiries, provide quotes for our services, and communicate with you about our cleaning services. We do not sell, trade, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.section3Text: Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience. Essential cookies are required for the website to function. Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors use our site. You can manage your cookie preferences at any time through the cookie settings on our website.
privacy.section4Text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy.section5Text: Under PIPEDA, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information below.
privacy.section6Text: If you have questions about this privacy policy or your personal data, please contact us at:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using the Parras General Services website or engaging our cleaning and maintenance services. By using our website or services, you agree to be bound by these terms.
terms.section1Text: Parras General Services provides commercial cleaning and maintenance services as described on our website. The specific services, frequency, and pricing will be agreed upon in writing between us and the client before any work begins.
terms.section2Text: Quotes provided through our website or by our team are estimates based on the information provided. Final pricing may vary depending on the actual scope of work, site conditions, and specific requirements identified during our evaluation.
terms.section3Text: All recurring cleaning services are subject to a written service agreement that outlines the scope of work, schedule, pricing, and cancellation terms. Either party may cancel with written notice as specified in the agreement.
terms.section4Text: Clients are responsible for providing safe access to the premises, disclosing any hazardous materials or conditions, and ensuring the work area is reasonably accessible for our cleaning team.
terms.section5Text: Parras General Services carries appropriate insurance coverage. We are not liable for pre-existing damage, normal wear and tear, or damage caused by improper maintenance by others. Any claims must be reported within 24 hours of service completion.
terms.section6Text: Your use of our website and services is also governed by our Privacy Policy. Please review our Privacy Policy for information on how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
terms.section7Text: We reserve the right to update these Terms of Service at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. Continued use of our website or services after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
